title: claim-issue.py race condition allows duplicate claims
description:
Two Claudes can both claim the same issue because claim-issue.py's race check is a single point-in-time snapshot. In the observed case, PRs #540 and #541 were created 2 seconds apart, both claiming send-chat-message-silent-failure. Claude A's PR #540 was initially for a different issue and got re-targeted mid-claim, so Claude B's race check didn't see it as a competitor.

The race window: between creating/updating the PR and running the race check, another Claude can do the same thing and neither sees the other.

Fix: after the initial race check passes, sleep 5 seconds and re-check. GitHub API propagation is typically sub-second, so a 5-second settle window ensures both PRs are visible.
